title: Academic Writing — Recycled glass tiles
description: Academic Task 1 visual report and Task 2 essay. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The diagram shows how waste glass is converted into tiles for interior walls.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

items.label: Collect
items.detail: Used glass is collected from communal bins.

items.label: Sort
items.detail: Workers remove metal and separate the glass by colour.

items.label: Crush
items.detail: The clean glass passes through a crusher.

items.label: Form
items.detail: Glass granules are placed in moulds with a binder.

items.label: Heat
items.detail: The filled moulds are heated in a kiln.

items.label: Finish
items.detail: Cooled tiles are polished and checked for cracks.

tasks.prompt:
Some argue that recycling targets should be mandatory for companies. Others favour voluntary schemes. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples.

Write at least 250 words.
